title: Feedback Form
prompt: Build a feedback form with a required email field, a select menu, a textarea, and a clear submit action.
objective: Use persistent labels and at least one browser constraint.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: select menus, textareas, validation.
hints: Native required and type constraints improve feedback; validate all submitted values again on the server.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.explanation: Reference approach: Native required and type constraints improve feedback; validate all submitted values again on the server. Required structural evidence: type="email", required, <select, <textarea, <label.

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
